evidence: A valid settlement can set release_approved to false, use GPLv3 and core_toolkit_only, exclude the connector, require SNAP-R filing, remove 312 records, include all four documented commitments, and reveal and justify PF1 through PF4. A settlement missing PF4 could plausibly omit the 312-record removal and fail C6, C10, and P4.
